description: Explicit build and packaging correspondences. Relation assertions retain their declared or observed evidence class; no parsing result establishes compilation, image contents or runtime behavior.

relations.description: The selected implementation is declared for or observed in the selected Cargo build target; compiler evidence is a separate obligation.
A selected Cargo target is declared to produce or observed producing an identified artifact.
A selected stage/image is declared to package or observed containing the identified artifact/configuration.
A selected stage/image launch command identifies the artifact; actual execution remains separate evidence.
